senses.definition: A person with the official task of overseeing the work of a person or group, or of other operations and activities.
senses.example: Near-synonyms: superintendent, manager, boss, executive, overseer

senses.definition: A person who monitors someone to make sure they comply with rules or other requirements set for them.
senses.example: Kashruth fraud in Brooklyn. Seems a goon squad of fake mashgichim or kosher supervisors have been making their way around the neighborhoods pulling surprise ‘inspections’ on different shops and restaurants, selling them fancy-looking certificates to put in the window […]

senses.definition: In certain states, an elected member of the governing body for a county which is called the board of supervisors.
A process responsible for managing other processes.
senses.example: The clock burst which enables the supervisor to housekeep the console input and output and to change program status is currently set to 200 ms.
